name: create-sia-app
description: Scaffold a private, encrypted storage app on the Sia network.

scripts.build: rm -rf ./dist && bun build src/index.ts --target node --format esm --packages external --outdir dist && rm -rf ./template && cp -r ../../template ./template && rm -rf ./template/node_modules ./template/dist ./template/test-results
scripts.dev: bun build src/index.ts --target node --format esm --packages external --outdir dist --watch
